column3: requireSecretGate (per-secret secrets.write; replaces the EnforceSecret*Permission call of the same decision) is a read of the ACTOR's own authority (#4161, the route gate moved into core). A concurrent revocation of that authority between the check and the write is equivalent to the revocation landing just after the write, the same as at the transport gate that already ran this check before calling core; no state the write depends on is decided by it.
